(3) YAML mirror parity: `scripts/yaml-mirror-parity-probe.py` -> 'engine: 55 rules (36 block / 9 sandbox / 10 allow)', '[ids] yaml=55 engine=55 only-in-yaml=[] only-in-engine=[] -> OK', '[totals] block=36/36 sandbox=9/9 allow=10/10 total=55/55 -> OK', 'ALL PROBES PASS', EXIT=0. (4) Backend parity: `scripts/backend-parity-battery.py` -> 'zero unexplained divergences: every cell is SAME, KNOWN-LIMIT (documented) or FAIL-CLOSED-PROVEN'; `--json` cell dump shows 0 DIFFERS cells (SAME x8, KNOWN-LIMIT x2 = unshare host /proc per docs/backend-parity.md known limit (a) at line 72, and FS uid-mapping per known limit (c) at line 324; FAIL-CLOSED-PROVEN x3). (5) Benchmarks: `scripts/arg_size_benchmark.py --ceiling-check` -> 'ceiling check OK (20x pins, see tests/test_arg_size_ceiling.py)' EXIT=0; `scripts/benchmark-interruptor.py` -> cold 3.77ms PASS (<50ms), warm 3.650ms PASS (<5ms), 1KB parse 0.316ms PASS (<10ms), 500-rule eval 0.136ms PASS (<5ms), EXIT=0; `scripts/bench_bridge.py` -> 'Cost guard OK: worst one-shot p50 164.2ms < 200ms ceiling' EXIT=0. (6) Isolation honesty: `scripts/pidns-capability-probe.py` -> 'FULL (backend: bwrap)' (per-backend verdict, not an all-green claim) and `scripts/fs-isolation-probe.py` -> 'DEGRADED: mapped launch failed (rc=1, stderr=unshare: setgroups failed: Operation not permitted); causes: uid-mapping denied ...
